subject.title: fix(compaction): prevent repeated restarts after safety timeouts

question: After the Pi timeout-helper regression is repaired, should OpenClaw persist a specifically marked native compaction result produced immediately after safety-timeout cancellation while the reason-owned settlement token remains open?
rationale: Source inspection supports the bounded mechanics, but changing the invariant from dropping every aborted compaction result to accepting one timeout-produced result affects authoritative session state and requires owner intent.

options.title: Accept bounded timeout commits
options.body: Keep the narrowly marked settlement window after restoring the Pi helper and require exact-head validation of both compaction runtimes.

options.title: Keep native compaction fail-closed
options.body: Retain inner chunk partial summaries and timeout guidance but remove the `AgentSession` path that commits after a safety-timeout abort.

options.title: Wait for full live proof
options.body: Hold the PR until a realistic slow-provider or full gateway compaction demonstrates recovery without duplicate or corrupted session state.

recommendation.title: Accept bounded timeout commits
recommendation.body: Keep the narrowly marked settlement window after restoring the Pi helper and require exact-head validation of both compaction runtimes.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR is assigned to vincentkoc and recent compaction-runtime history makes him the clearest available owner for this policy choice.
